prompt.zh-TW: 阿邦的「速達機車行」把倉庫裡全部的零件以 {{money:e1.price}} 賒銷給一家車隊，貨款下個月才收。這筆交易之後，下面四個數字各會怎麼變？
prompt.en: Bang’s workshop Swift Scooter Repairs sells all the parts in its storeroom to a delivery fleet on credit for {{money:e1.price}}, to be collected next month. After this transaction, how does each of the four figures below change?

explanation.zh-TW: 營業收入增加 {{money:e1.price}}，應收帳款也增加同樣的金額，現金一毛都沒動。間接法裡這筆交易牽動三列：稅前淨利因毛利而增加 {{money:e1.grossProfit}}；「{{term:tm_873r9bx9}}」這一列扣掉整筆還沒收到的貨款 {{money:e1.price}}；存貨減少 {{money:e1.costOfAllInventory}}，在「{{term:tm_bpt2kp5c}}」這一列以正數加回。三列合計為零，所以{{term:tm_e61ht6yh}}不變。應收帳款變多，代表的是錢還沒進來。
explanation.en: Revenue rises by {{money:e1.price}} and trade receivables rise by the same amount, while cash does not move at all. In the indirect method this transaction touches three lines: profit before tax rises by the gross profit of {{money:e1.grossProfit}}; the {{term:tm_873r9bx9}} line deducts the whole uncollected price of {{money:e1.price}}; and inventories fall by {{money:e1.costOfAllInventory}}, which is added back as a positive figure on the {{term:tm_bpt2kp5c}} line. The three lines net to nil, so {{term:tm_e61ht6yh}} is unchanged. A rise in receivables means the money has not arrived.
